notes.title: Discover the Explorers Collection: The Oregon Trail & Carmen Sandiego Bundle
notes.content:
Made for Curious Minds!
The Explorers Collection brings together the recently released reinterpretations of The Oregon Trail and Carmen Sandiego.



Uncover mysteries across continents and brave the wild frontier in this premium bundle celebrating two of gaming's most iconic adventures.



Whether you're a seasoned sleuth, a trailblazing tactician, or a curious newcomer, the Explorers Collection is your passport to discovery.

notes.title: Get Your Hunting Game On with Hold Your Horses Time-Limited Event
notes.content:
🎯🐗 Attention all hunters! 

Get your rifles primed, powder horns filled, and bullets at the ready for the ultimate hunting experience with the time-limited event - "Hold Your Horses"! 🐎💨 With animals that flee from gunshots and bullets that pierce through them, this is not the typical hunting game you got used to. Don't dally 🏃, claim your spot and take aim at the ultimate hunting challenge!

Connect with fellow hunters on our game-dedicated Discord server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/0f9b089a0f62f1ed3c37dfcacd61a2391f8e2945.png

notes.title: Survive the Troubled Waters: A Time-Limited Challenge in The Oregon Trail
notes.content:
Experience the ultimate test of survival skills at Pandemonium, a time-limited event that promises chaos and randomness.

In this exciting journey, all character stats start at 1 and are randomized with every skill use. Members of your party are selected randomly, adding an extra challenge to the game. Pandemonium is a chaotic remix of the trail that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Don't miss this event and join the adventure of a lifetime!

Need a piece of advice to make your journey across The Oregon Trail easier? Join us on Discord and connect with a vibrant community of fellow pioneers who are ready to share their knowledge and experience with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/25323752c0a4bd9d0a547e2c4e76de04c6cb052c.png

notes.title: Survive the Troubled Waters: A Time-Limited Challenge in The Oregon Trail
notes.content:
Get ready to brave the elements in a new challenge: an unstable raft that's drifting toward the shore. 

Will you be able to navigate the rough waters and reach the highest score?

But that's not all. The screen will randomly go dark, leaving you stranded in the wilderness with limited visibility. And to make matters even more challenging, it's always raining. If you're up for the challenge, join us on the trail and connect with other players on our game-dedicated Discord server. Share your progress, strategies, and high scores, and see how you stack up against other adventurers. 

[previewyoutube=os8JHMNQOks;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Don't Move, Take Aim, and Score Big!
notes.content:
Massive animals have been discovered in a lost corner of the map!
But these jumbo beasts have sharp ears, and they'll startle at your every move. Take on this new Special Contract and bag yourself “The Big Bucks.”

Modifiers:
- Animals are giant.
- Moving reduces your score.
- Each shot spends points (instead of bullets).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/5f13779fd15e285fbad642d5d522446023c89ed8.png

notes.title: Feed Your Appetite for Adventure with this Weekly Challenge
notes.content:
Escorting this party of hungry hungry pilgrims will require more food than your wagon can handle! Luckily, you've got more than enough ammo and an especially bountiful hunting ground to keep the feasts flowing in this new Special Contract, “Gluttony.”

Modifiers:
- Characters consume three times as much food.
- Hunting yields triple the food and pelts.
- The party has unlimited bullets.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/1ad44cb53fe4997101235674f88082a1e719390d.png

notes.title: How Long Can You Stay Afloat?
notes.content:
You're up the creek without a paddle in this Special Contract.

Brave the mighty Columbia River as long as possible while trying to steer your raft as little as possible. But even a single slip-up can mean you're sunk in “One False Move.”

Modifiers:
- Your raft has only one life.
- You lose points for moving left or right.
- Damage to your raft is repaired every few yards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/c2605fa48b01bd114cfcefdb55274285babf7a93.png

notes.title: Dare to Travel this Treacherous Trail?
notes.content:
Some paths are so perilous, they're only traveled by those brave enough, strong enough, or lost enough to take them on.

See if you can survive such hardships in the new Special Contract, “Chronic Conditions.”

Modifiers:
- All characters start with max stats.
- Random stat increases become decreases instead.
- Status effects can't be removed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/898f596b54f44cd3205be4c032d091baf68a4af9.png

notes.title: Go on a Hunting Spree in This Week's Special Event
notes.content:
Everyone's a marksman when hunting a giant buffalo.

But can you handle swarms of itty-bitty critters moving at lighting fast speeds?

Then set your sights on the Special Contract, “Swarm Regards” and prove yourself a master hunter!

Modifiers:
- Hunting mini-game has three times as many animals.
- Animal speed is greatly increased.
- All animals are tiny.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/e3c5a5dcd81aabd670446b18acad66d13d7febce.png

notes.title: Play Tips #2: Shopping
notes.content:
Buying the right supplies can make a huge difference to your chance of survival.

There's a variety of goods for sale at forts, think carefully about what you need.

Don't spend all your money in one place, you might need it later.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageA.png

Think carefully about your choice of wagon, you won't be going anywhere without it!

Your choice of wagon determines how many oxen you'll be bringing.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB1.png

It's always a good idea to purchase food and ammunition before you depart.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB2.png

Keep your wagon in good repair by purchasing toolboxes, grease, and spare parts.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB3.png

Keep a supply of medicine for emergencies, it could save your life!

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB4.png

Fresh clothes are perfect for keeping your party warm and clean.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB5.png

Need a stamina boost? Try giving your party some coffee.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-2/Tip02_ImageB6.png

notes.title: Play Tips #1: Party Drafting
notes.content:
When you're drafting a party, make sure to select a combination of different classes.

Every character has their own combination of traits, both good and bad.
 
You may discover unique outcomes based on the traits of your characters.

Every class has a special item that they bring with them.


https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageA.jpg

Remember to give your party a mixture of different strengths.

You can rename your party after drafting them. Try naming them after your friends!

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageB1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43101450/053b64af434b3f9a57bce94a47b4c200fe7ed194.png

There's a diverse selection of characters to pick from, choose who you like best.

You can unlock new classes by playing the game and completing journeys.

You'll have new characters to choose from every time you play.

https://d10wvc9xpkv5xm.cloudfront.net/assets/articles/theoregontrail/play-tips-1/Tip01_ImageC.png
